title: gossypium nanking f. rubicundum
intro: Gossypium nanking f. rubicundum, commonly known as the Red Cotton Tree, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant is a member of the cotton plant family and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The Red Cotton Tree is known to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating conditions like wounds, fever, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Gossypium nanking f. rubicundum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
